- Salary starting at € 18.30 per hour!

Who you are
To supply the hospitality industry in Hoofddorp and Amsterdam, it is important that you meet the following requirements as a truck driver C:

At Bidfood in Hoofddorp, you step inside the coziest supplier with a very nice, informal working atmosphere!

- You work with a fixed weekly schedule that is known a week in advance, nice and clear for your private life! 📅
